summary: @servicetitan/marketing-ui@9.3.1 preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/...zip`, extracts it, chmods it executable, and invokes it against `math_init.js` — a 727KB single-line obfuscated script at the tarball root that uses a string-array rotator over a ~1000-element mixed string/hex array (obfuscator.io shape). The payload is executed by a freshly-downloaded alternate interpreter, bypassing Node-based tooling. `math_init.js` is not declared in `package.json`'s `files` array (which lists only `dist` and `src`), despite being present in the tarball and being the target of the preinstall dropper. The package advertises React marketing components; there is no build- or runtime-related purpose for pulling a second language runtime at install time to run an obfuscated sibling file. This shape (alternate-runtime dropper + heavily obfuscated payload + undeclared tarball blob + purpose mismatch) matches install-time remote code execution on any machine that runs `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
